newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian industrial output 2.6 pct down in May.
newsitem.headline: Romanian industrial output 2.6 pct down in May.

text.p: Romania's industrial output fell by 2.6 percent in May after an 11.3 percent drop in April, the National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Friday.
It said output in the food and beverage sectors saw the steepest decline in May falling by 22.8 percent, while the machinery and equipment industry had falls ranging from 30 to 50 percent.
The power sector fell sharply by 27.4 percent last month, when the manufacturing industry was 0.6 percent down. Output in the extractive sector saw a 2.3 percent rise from April.
Industrial output stood at 13.85 trillion lei in May, with the five-month figure at 57.49 trillion lei, or 6.1 percent up from January-May 1996, CNS data showed.
Inventories accounted for 66.3 percent of May production, up from 65.1 percent the previous month.
Some 23 percent of the May output was exported, up from 19.8 percent in the year-ago period.
Industry employed 5.529 million people at end-May, 26,000 more than the previous month.
